scope: Tracked public production deployment source and the setup-time values checkout: OpenTofu image authorities, Ansible remote artifact/source/container consumers, the tooling-image build, and the operator-selected private values Git clone. Health probes, documentation, test fixtures, and update metadata lookups are not installer consumers. Repository-owned mutable executable acquisitions must use the protected controller-side reviewed cache; cache ingestion is an explicitly separate operator operation.
evidence_scope: Source-static completion means canonical version and architecture-specific SHA-256 ownership, projection, and fail-closed cache consumption are implemented. It does not claim that private site pins or matching cache artifacts have been populated, reviewed, or exercised; those remain separate private and operator evidence.
